records.academicNote: Accounting accepts students without a business/commerce background; business degrees, accounting work and good GMAT/GRE scores are preferences, not mandatory entry gates. Three concentrations remain one award. Ordinary single concentration has twelve courses; double concentration has fourteen and extra course fees. Mandatory economics/statistics/accounting preparation and course-exemption approval do not guarantee exemption, fee reduction or automatic professional membership. Portal expected duration is two years; programme text still mentions one-year double-concentration completion, so confirm the cohort timetable.

Accounting Analytics is a distinct award from Master of Accounting, not its concentration or an additional degree created by the data analytics curriculum. The current entry section gives bachelor/equivalent, two references and conditional English evidence, without an exclusive accounting major, numeric GPA or fixed work years. Ten courses and optional cross-programme electives are curriculum requirements.

AI in Business is a distinct Business School degree, separate from Science AI and Computer Science AI streams. The consulted entry section establishes no exclusive prior computing degree, coding-test minimum, numeric GPA or fixed work years. Curriculum topics do not become compulsory pre-entry qualifications.

Ordinary taught MEcon welcomes different academic backgrounds; admitted students without economics preparation must complete the summer preparatory teaching and assessments. Data Analysis, Policy, Theory and Advanced Research remain curriculum streams, not extra degrees. The Advanced Research stream separately requires strong academic/research evidence, two academic references and a two-page research statement; a writing sample is optional. These additional research-stream documents, thesis length, PhD opportunity and conditional second-year support are not universal ordinary-MEcon entry or fee rules.

Family Wealth Management is jointly offered with HKIHSS and is distinct from Master of Wealth Management. Submit a roughly 300-word family-member-day essay. A scholarship statement of at most 300 words applies only when requesting scholarship consideration; it is not an additional compulsory scholarship application or an automatic award. Family ownership, minimum family assets, prior finance employment and fixed work years are not established admission gates.

Ordinary Finance is an interdisciplinary taught programme; curriculum references to mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering and programming do not establish an exclusive undergraduate major list or numeric GPA. Approved advanced standing may adjust fees, excluding the capstone; no automatic discount or personal adjusted quote is calculated.

Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics and science/technology-related backgrounds are HIGHLY PREFERRED, not universally mandatory. This Business School degree is distinct from the CDS Financial Technology and Data Analytics part-time degree and retains its own fee, study mode and intake. Advanced standing and any adjusted fees need approval.

Global Management accepts bachelor/equivalent and the stated evidence. The portal preference for good GMAT/GRE, a business degree or accounting-related work remains a preference, not a required job or major gate. Company visits, global opportunities and marketing examples do not establish compulsory overseas delivery in the consulted entry section.

Business Analytics curriculum and career examples do not create a mandatory computing major, numeric GPA, work-year or GMAT/GRE minimum. Readiness for quantitative work and complete evidence remain assessed by the programme. No job or placement guarantee is inferred.

Marketing retains bachelor/equivalent and conditional English/documentary evidence. No mandatory previous marketing degree, fixed employment years, numerical GPA or GMAT/GRE minimum is established in the consulted entry section. Curriculum specialisms and employers do not create extra degrees or entry qualifications.

Sustainable Accounting and Finance is distinct from Accounting and ordinary Finance. ESG topics, the Paris Agreement two-degree target and career narratives are not GPA thresholds, professional licences or work-year requirements. Advanced standing and fee adjustments require approval and do not waive the capstone automatically.

Wealth Management is distinct from Family Wealth Management and retains its own curriculum, ordinary admissions and fee record. The Family Wealth Management essay is not imposed here. No required wealth amount, family-business ownership or fixed work years is established. Advanced standing and any fee adjustment require approval.

boundaries.specialisedMasters: Twelve named specialised masters, each FT only, own portal expected duration two years and unknown start month. Shared 2027 fee table is a whole-programme total; first-year instalments/older one-year completion text do not settle the cohort timetable.
boundaries.rounds: All twelve portal bodies show 24 July, 28 September and 4 December 2026 at noon for 2027 intake. Latest announced Round 2 is not a complete-cycle final date. Do not copy stale indexed upcoming-round headers or invent opening.
boundaries.references: Two references, at least one academic with university directory/profile URL for specialised masters; reference deadline and two-working-day supporting deadline differ. MBA uses own reference instructions.
boundaries.tests: Specialised masters optional GMAT/GRE; TOEFL Home rejected per exam only, IELTS One Skill Retake manually assessed. MBA FT GMAT/GRE required, PT GMAT/GRE/GRK/EA with possible strict-more-than-seven-year assessed exemption; no numeric aptitude cutoff.
boundaries.mba: FT IELTS 6.5 versus own current PT-HK 6.0; generic central rule and old FAQ cohort kept separate. Both require two post-degree full-time work years as of August 2027; undated aggregate profile cannot verify it.
boundaries.delivery: FT allows Hong Kong continuation but ALL students start with a one-week Shanghai/Beijing immersion. This is an offering-specific unresolved geographic condition, not a claim of an HK-only path or an exclusion of PT Hong Kong. Overseas partner tracks, GBA HK-SZ mode and separate IMBA are not selectable.
boundaries.accounting: Non-business applicants accepted; double concentration adds courses/fees. Professional recognition, boot camps, course exemptions and registration outcomes remain separate.
boundaries.economics: Different backgrounds welcomed; non-economics preparation is post-admission. Advanced Research stream statement/references/thesis/scholarship conditions are not ordinary universal entry rules.
boundaries.familyWealth: 300-word essay required; max-300-word scholarship statement conditional. Do not impose these on the separate Wealth Management award.
boundaries.fees: Named 2027 specialised totals/deposits and 780 application fee; no invented local/non-local tiers. MBA deposits not automatically added/subtracted without verified credit accounting. No 2026-only FTSS or automatic scholarship deduction.

preservation: Prior 238 checked parents, 26 route snapshots, 184 contexts, directory/scope decisions, original core, workbook/history and protected refs preserved.
sourceLimits: Partial observations only; no full HKU census, independent reviewer, live-open claim, full admission eligibility or real user testing. Per-mode FT immersion remains explicit and unresolved; do not state that every MBA path is Hong Kong-only.
